::: {.why}
Overlapping observations and persistent regressors are how predictive regressions in this field are usually run, and the standard errors that come out of ordinary least squares are wrong by a factor you can compute.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Say what Newey-West is estimating and why the naive standard error is too small under positive residual autocorrelation.
- Show how much the t-statistic on your own predictive regression moves under three different lag truncation choices.
